profile.reading:
Sabey Data Centers operates SDC Seattle, a two-part data center campus in Tukwila, King County, Washington, marketed by the operator as the West Coast's largest privately owned data center campus. Sabey traces its roots to 1972, when Dave Sabey founded Sabey Corporation as a Pacific Northwest commercial real estate developer; the company entered the data center business almost by accident during the dot-com collapse, when a vacated tenant building in this same Tukwila location became SDC Seattle Building 5, prompting Sabey's pivot into the data center industry. Sabey Data Centers itself was formally established in 2010 as a joint venture between Sabey Corporation and institutional investor National Real Estate Advisors, a structure confirmed on both the operator's own site and independently by Wikipedia. As of 2026 Sabey operates seven data center campuses nationally, together totaling more than 3.5 million square feet and, per Wikipedia's most recent figure, nearly 400 MW of capacity; Tim Mirick became Sabey's president effective January 1, 2025, succeeding Rob Rockwood.

Per the operator's own SDC Seattle page, the Tukwila campus totals more than a million square feet and 54 MW of capacity campus-wide, a figure not broken out per individual building and not applied to any single structure here. Aggregator sourcing indicates the campus actually comprises two separately addressed sub-campuses: Intergate.East, at a street range of 3311 to 3511 South 120th Place, Tukwila, WA 98168, spanning roughly 1.2 million square feet; and Intergate.West, at 12101 to 12301 Tukwila International Boulevard, Tukwila, WA 98168, built in 1999 and spanning roughly 173,000 square feet.

This building, Intergate.West Building A, sits on the Intergate.West sub-campus. Aggregator sourcing gives specific, distinct street numbers for neighboring Buildings C (12101) and B (12201) within the shared 12101-12301 Tukwila International Boulevard range, but no distinct number specific to Building A has been located in sourcing to date; the campus range is applied here rather than a guessed figure, even though 12301 would be the sole remaining number within the stated range not already assigned to a neighbor, since that pattern is suggestive rather than sourced.

reading.body:
Intergate Seattle West Building A is one of three buildings on the Intergate.West subcomponent of the Sabey Data Centers Seattle campus in Tukwila, Washington. The operator publishes 54 MW of total capacity across the full Seattle campus but does not publish a figure specific to this building. The Intergate.West subcomponent occupies roughly 173,000 square feet built in 1999, substantially smaller than the Intergate.East subcomponent at the same campus.

Published capacity at the Seattle campus ranks third among all mapped facilities in Washington state by operator-disclosed megawatts. Washington state has 46 mapped data center facilities total, of which only two operators have published capacity figures to this site. The 54 MW Tukwila campus represents the entire 60 MW of published capacity disclosed by operators in the state, giving Sabey's published footprint a dominant share of transparent capacity reporting in Washington despite the presence of many unmeasured facilities.

The facility carries Tier III standard certification, qualifying it for colocation and cloud infrastructure hosting. Power sourcing for the Seattle campus is not published at the building level. The binding constraint on this facility's contribution to AI scaling cannot be determined from published specifications.
